line: RULES CHANGED: rooms/{CODE}/jw/{matchId}/{uid} — JAYWALK's proof node (H1: NEW — go · c/{i} · e; H3: every chunk c/{i} = { s, at } — its packed hops + the SERVER's timestamp (at === now), written ONCE, i 0-9999; H4: + k = { w, at } — Call the Winner: only once the caller's own `e` is there, a player still in, once, the server's time) + still waiting from FR7 FIXES B: rooms/{CODE}/prism/{m}, oc/{m}, ocm/{m} (the host may delete ONE match's node — A SEAT IS NOT A PLAY) — RE-PUBLISH database.rules.json in the Firebase console (Realtime Database → Rules → paste the whole file → Publish); until then the old rules run: the old matches' nodes stay until the room is deleted (the fallback), and EVERY JAYWALK run — solo or a match — plays UNPROVEN and is never counted (no ghosts, no live order, no call: nothing of a run can be written).
